codec.header: 16-byte wrapper followed by the original 48-byte GPR3 header verbatim
codec.dictionary: First occurrence order of distinct 16-byte little-endian Float64 XY pairs, equality by exact bits including signed zero; each dictionary record 16 bytes
codec.point_record: Original point order, UInt32 XY dictionary index + original 8-byte Float64 Z; 12 bytes per point
codec.topology: Original GPR3 patch records copied verbatim; no welding of XYZ points or discontinuous PT elevations
codec.roundtrip: All original GPR3 bytes, node order, Z values, topology, bounds, reserved fields and SHA-256 must restore exactly
codec.bounds: At most 20000 points, 8192 records, 2000000 original/compact bytes; reject malformed or unused/repeated dictionary entries and trailing bytes

selection: Apply this identical lossless codec to every distinct binary in all six methods and both fields/seven directions. Recompute finite minima using actual complete compact file bytes, retain original E2 only after exact full-byte restoration. Same eligibility and tie rules as the frozen finite-frontier protocol; no interpolation or missing-baseline wins.
scope: Post-hoc encoding fairness audit on a fully observed archive, fixed before new compact-file measurements. No new fitting, meshes, error experiments, ArcGIS run or theoretical minimum plane-coefficient claim. The codec can increase file size; retain increases and all P2/loss controls. No memory or CPU performance inference.
correction: The v1 declared publication view path while pinning the complete report hash. Input validation rejected it before directory creation or any archive-model encoding. This version changes only the path to that existing complete report; all methods, thresholds, codec and selection rules are unchanged.
